fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY) posted record Q3 profit significantly exceeding guidance, prompting Wedbush to raise price target from KRW 2.56M to KRW 3.00M, maintaining Outperform rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: DRAM and NAND prices rose sequentially more than 20%, shipments increased, and Wedbush expects memory supply shortage through 2030, supporting accelerated growth.
fields.summary_ko.2: Since US listing in July, achieved $1.18T market cap as largest foreign company IPO, though recent three-month return underperformed S&P 500.
